title: Gesang der Jünglinge
notes: Sped-up boy's voice dissolving into sine tones and clicks, spun around five loudspeakers.

title: Kontakte
notes: Four-channel tape meets live piano and percussion; electronic doubles of struck sounds.

title: Hymnen
notes: Two-hour tape collage of shortwave radio and national anthems morphing into each other.

title: Stimmung
notes: Six voices sustaining one chord's overtones; magic names, deities, erotic poems; ritual stillness.
